description: A theme park transports its visitors around the park either by scooter or rickshaw. A scooter can carry 2 people while a rickshaw can carry 3 people. To avoid excessive pollution, at most 40% of the vehicles used can be rickshaws. If the park needs to transport at least 300 visitors, minimize the total number of scooters used.

ScooterCapacity.definition: Capacity of a scooter in number of people

RickshawCapacity.definition: Capacity of a rickshaw in number of people

MaxRickshawPercentage.definition: Maximum percentage of vehicles that can be rickshaws

objective.description: "Minimize the total number of scooters used to transport at least 300 visitors"

constraints.description: Number of scooters >= 0, Number of rickshaws >= 0
Number of scooters and number of rickshaws are integers

Scooters.definition: Number of scooters used to transport visitors

Rickshaws.definition: Number of rickshaws used to transport visitors
